arxiv-1312-6977.title: A Note on Symmetric properties of the multiple q q -Euler zeta functions and higher-order q q -Euler polynomials
arxiv-1312-6977.creator: Dae San Kim and Taekyun Kim
arxiv-1312-6977.description: A 2013 arXiv research paper by Dae San Kim and Taekyun Kim. Recently, the higher-order q q -Euler polynomials and multiple q q -Euler zeta functions are introduced by T. Kim ( [ key-8 , key-7 ] ). In this paper, we investigate some symmetric properties of the multiple q q -Euler zeta function and derive various identities concerning the higher-order q q -Euler polynomials from the symmetric properties of the multiple q q -Euler zeta functions.

arxiv-2012-08047.title: Cosmological advection flows in the presence of primordial black holes as dark matter and formation of first sources
arxiv-2012-08047.creator: A. Kashlinsky
arxiv-2012-08047.description: Abstract In the inflation-based cosmology the dark matter (DM) density component starts moving with respect to the universal expansion at z eq ∼ 3,200 z_{\rm eq}\sim 3,200 while baryons remain frozen until z rec ∼ 1,100 z_{\rm rec}\sim 1,100 .

arxiv-2101-03151.title: Quantum Error Mitigation using Symmetry Expansion
arxiv-2101-03151.creator: Zhenyu Cai
arxiv-2101-03151.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Zhenyu Cai. Even with the recent rapid developments in quantum hardware, noise remains the biggest challenge for the practical applications of any near-term quantum devices. Full quantum error correction cannot be implemented in these devices due to their limited scale. Therefore instead of relying on engineered code symmetry, symmetry verification was developed which uses the inherent symmetry within the physical problem we try to solve.

arxiv-2103-00897.title: Capacitance and Structure of Electric Double Layers: Comparing Brownian Dynamics and Classical Density Functional Theory
arxiv-2103-00897.creator: Peter Cats, Ranisha S. Sitlapersad, Wouter K. den Otter, Anthony R. Thornton, René van Roij
arxiv-2103-00897.description: Abstract We present a study of the structure and differential capacitance of electric double layers of aqueous electrolytes. We consider Electric Double Layer Capacitors (EDLC) composed of spherical cations and anions in a dielectric continuum confined between a planar cathode and anode. The model system includes steric as well as Coulombic ion-ion and ion-electrode interactions.

arxiv-2202-04688.title: The Solar Neighborhood XLIX: New Discoveries and Orbits of M Dwarf Multiples with Speckle Interferometry at SOAR Facilities: CTIO:0.9 m, CTIO:SOAR
arxiv-2202-04688.creator: Eliot Halley Vrijmoet, Andrei Tokovinin, Todd J. Henry, Jennifer G. Winters, Elliott Horch, Wei-Chun Jao
arxiv-2202-04688.description: Abstract We present the first results of a multi-year program to map the orbits of M dwarf multiples within 25 parsecs. The observations were conducted primarily during 2019–2020 using speckle interferometry at the Southern Astrophysical Research (SOAR) Telescope in Chile, using the High-Resolution Camera mounted on the adaptive optics module (HRCam+SAM).

arxiv-2206-06893.title: Possible Coexistence of Antiferromagnetic and Ferromagnetic Spin Fluctuations in the Spin-triplet Superconductor UTe 2 Revealed by 125 Te NMR under Pressure
arxiv-2206-06893.creator: Devi V. Ambika, Qing-Ping Ding, Khusboo Rana, Corey E. Frank, Elizabeth L. Green, Sheng Ran, Nicholas P. Butch, Yuji Furukawa
arxiv-2206-06893.description: Abstract A spin-triplet superconducting state mediated by ferromagnetic (FM) spin fluctuations has been suggested to occur in the newly discovered heavy-fermion superconductor UTe 2 . However, the recent neutron scattering measurements revealed the presence of antiferromagnetic (AFM) spin fluctuations in UTe 2 .

arxiv-2206-11839.title: Annealing Optimisation of Mixed ZX Phase Circuits
arxiv-2206-11839.creator: Stefano Gogioso, Richie Yeung
arxiv-2206-11839.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Stefano Gogioso, Richie Yeung. We present a topology-aware optimisation technique for circuits of mixed ZX phase gadgets, based on conjugation by CX gates and simulated annealing. 1
Introduction

In this work, we build upon the Master’s thesis by one of the authors
[
19
]
and present a topology-aware optimisation technique for circuits of mixed ZX phase gadgets, based on conjugation by CX gates and simulated annealing.

arxiv-2303-09221.title: Physics-based model of solar wind stream interaction regions: Interfacing between Multi-VP and 1D MHD for operational forecasting at L1
arxiv-2303-09221.creator: R. Kieokaew, R. F. Pinto, E. Samara, C. Tao, M. Indurain, B. Lavraud, A. Brunet, V. Génot, A. Rouillard, N. André, S. Bourdarie, C. Katsavrias, F. Darrouzet, B. Grison, I. Daglis
arxiv-2303-09221.description: Abstract Our current capability of space weather prediction in the Earth’s radiation belts is limited to only an hour in advance using the real-time solar wind monitoring at the Lagrangian L1 point. To mitigate the impacts of space weather on telecommunication satellites, several frameworks were proposed to advance the lead time of the prediction.

arxiv-2409-14518.title: RPKI: Not Perfect But Good Enough Conference: ; September; 2024
arxiv-2409-14518.creator: Haya Schulmann, Niklas Vogel, Michael Waidner
arxiv-2409-14518.description: Abstract . The Resource Public Key Infrastructure (RPKI) protocol was standardized to add cryptographic security to Internet routing. With over 50% of Internet resources protected with RPKI today, the protocol already impacts significant parts of Internet traffic ( NIST 2024 ) . In addition to its growing adoption, there is also increasing political interest in RPKI.

arxiv-2503-17813.title: Connectedness: A Dimension of Security Bug Severity Assessment For Measuring Uncertainty
arxiv-2503-17813.creator: Chan Shue Long
arxiv-2503-17813.description: Abstract Current frameworks for evaluating security bug severity, such as the Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS), prioritize the ratio of exploitability to impact. This paper suggests that the above approach measures the "known knowns" but inadequately addresses the "known unknowns" especially when there exist multiple possible exploit paths and side effects, which introduce significant uncertainty.

arxiv-2509-18469.title: Probabilistic Geometric Principal Component Analysis with application to neural data
arxiv-2509-18469.creator: Han-Lin Hsieh, Maryam M. Shanechi
arxiv-2509-18469.description: Abstract Dimensionality reduction is critical across various domains of science including neuroscience. Probabilistic Principal Component Analysis (PPCA) is a prominent dimensionality reduction method that provides a probabilistic approach unlike the deterministic approach of PCA and serves as a connection between PCA and Factor Analysis (FA).

arxiv-2602-11761.title: MiniCPM-SALA: Hybridizing Sparse and Linear Attention for Efficient Long-Context Modeling
arxiv-2602-11761.creator: MiniCPM Team
arxiv-2602-11761.description: Abstract The evolution of large language models (LLMs) towards applications with ultra-long contexts faces challenges posed by the high computational and memory costs of the Transformer architecture. While existing sparse and linear attention mechanisms attempt to mitigate these issues, they typically involve a trade-off between memory efficiency and model performance.

arxiv-2602-12269.title: Certification of linear optical quantum state preparation
arxiv-2602-12269.creator: Riko Schadow, Naomi Spier, Stefan N. van den Hoven, Malaquias Correa Anguita, Redlef B.G. Braamhaar, Sara Marzban, Jens Eisert, Jelmer J. Renema, Nathan Walk
arxiv-2602-12269.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Riko Schadow, Naomi Spier, Stefan N. van den Hoven, Malaquias Correa Anguita, Redlef B.G. Braamhaar, Sara Marzban, Jens Eisert, Jelmer J. Renema, Nathan Walk. Certification is important to guarantee the correct functioning of quantum devices. A key certification task is verifying that a device has produced a desired output state.

plos-pone-0347846.title: Traffic flow prediction via dynamic hypergraph learning
plos-pone-0347846.creator: SiWei Wei, Yang Yang, ChunZhi Wang
plos-pone-0347846.description: Traffic flow prediction via dynamic hypergraph learning

pmc-10612502.title: The Effectiveness of Nigella sativa and Ginger as Appetite Suppressants: An Experimental Study on Healthy Wistar Rats [Letter]
pmc-10612502.creator: Adam Arditya Fajriawan, Risqa Novita
pmc-10612502.description: tential of utilizing Nigella sativa and ginger, two herbal remedies, for mitigating obesity. The significance of this research is particularly pertinent considering the alarming statistics provided by the World Health Organization (WHO) indicating that, as of 2022, over one billion individuals worldwide suffer from obesity. Among them, 650 million are adults, 340 million are adolescents, and 39 million are children.

pmc-10668561.title: Histopathological changes in the electrical conduction of cardiac nodes after acute myocardial infarction in dogs and horses, compared with findings in humans: A histological, morphometrical, and immunohistochemical study
pmc-10668561.creator: Fabián Gómez-Torres, Luis Ballesteros-Acuña, Amparo Ruíz-Sauri
pmc-10668561.description: Background and Aim:The heart conduction system is responsible for the occurrence of various types of cardiac arrhythmia. This study aimed to histologically and morphometrically describe damaged cardiac nodes during acute myocardial infarction and to compare them with normal tissues in dogs and horses.

pmc-11508934.title: The Gross Anatomical and Histological Features of the Humerus in African Green Monkeys (Chlorocebus sabaeus) from Saint Kitts and Nevis, West Indies
pmc-11508934.creator: Cristian Olimpiu Martonos, Alexandru Ion Gudea, William Brady Little, Florin Gheorghe Stan, Călin Lațiu, Pompei Bolfa, Cristian Constantin Dezdrobitu
pmc-11508934.description: This paper presents a detailed gross description of all anatomical elements of the humerus in the African green monkey and provides comparative and differential elements on monkey osteology. The osteometric investigation adds value to the gross morphological investigation, adjoining metric data to the gross descriptive data set.

pmc-11577370.title: Prognostic prediction models for postoperative patients with stage I to III colorectal cancer based on machine learning
pmc-11577370.creator: Xiao-Lin Ji, Shuo Xu, Xiao-Yu Li, Jin-Huan Xu, Rong-Shuang Han, Ying-Jie Guo, Li-Ping Duan, Zi-Bin Tian
pmc-11577370.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Colorectal cancer (CRC) is characterized by high heterogeneity, aggressiveness, and high morbidity and mortality rates. With machine learning (ML) algorithms, patient, tumor, and treatment features can be used to develop and validate models for predicting survival.

pmc-11712618.title: Towards predicting individual cognitive trajectories in AD using Quantitative Systems Pharmacology
pmc-11712618.creator: Ivo Schuttel, Shaina M Short, Hugo Geerts
pmc-11712618.description: BackgroundWhile a number of recent anti‐amyloid antibodies demonstrated a robust reduction of amyloid biomarkers in clinical trials, the impact on functional improvement is much more variable. We hypothesize that this larger variability is driven by comedications, common genotype variants and underlying tau pathology.

pmc-12387888.title: Are Dietary and Serum Advanced Glycation End Products (AGEs) Potential Contributors to Inflammation in Women with Polycystic Ovary Syndrome?
pmc-12387888.creator: Merve Yurt, Hülya Gökmen-Özel, Johannes Ott
pmc-12387888.description: Background/Objectives: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is an endocrine disorder characterized by metabolic and hormonal imbalances in women of reproductive age. Various studies have emphasized that a diet high in advanced glycation end products (AGEs) and high serum AGE levels may be associated with reproductive and metabolic dysfunction in PCOS.

pmc-12584043.title: The effect of regulating focus tendencies on college students’ sports anomie behavior: the mediating role of autonomous and controlled motivation
pmc-12584043.creator: Yimeng Ma, Laibing Lu, Bin Gu, Jinfu Xu, Mingliang Chen
pmc-12584043.description: IntroductionThis study aimed to investigate the relationship between regulatory focus and sports anomie behavior among university students, examining the potential mediating roles of autonomous and controlled motivation.MethodsA survey was conducted with 2,128 university students using the Long-Term Regulatory Focus Scale, the Behavioral Regulation in Sport Questionnaire, and the College Students’ Sports Anomie Behavior Scale.

pmc-12820240.title: Differentiation between patent foramen ovale and pulmonary arteriovenous malformations via simultaneous contrast transthoracic echocardiography and transcranial doppler
pmc-12820240.creator: Jingjin Wang, Zhenhui Zhu, Hong Meng, Changming Xiong, Linyuan Wan, Hongxia Qi, Jiande Wang, Qianqian Liu, Yanhua Wang, Jing Dong, Shiguo Li
pmc-12820240.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The objective is to differentiate between patent foramen ovale (PFO) and pulmonary arteriovenous malformations (PAVM) using simultaneous contrast transthoracic echocardiography (cTTE) and contrast transcranial cerebral Doppler (cTCD). A total of 193 patients suspected of having a right-to-left shunt were classified into four groups based on the reference standard, including PFO (n = 102), PAVM (n = 18), negative subjects (n = 53), and indeterminate group (n = 20). Simultaneous cTTE and cTCD were performed in all patients.

pmc-12966421.title: Axin1 stabilizes S-opsin and maintains cone photoreceptor survival by inhibiting GSK3β activity
pmc-12966421.creator: Jinying Xu, Jianhui Man, Yingying Fan, Yuewen Chen, Yu Chen
pmc-12966421.description: To ensure high phototransduction efficiency in the retina, the precise subcellular localization of signaling molecules must be tightly orchestrated by scaffold proteins. Aberrant localization of these scaffold proteins not only disrupts the transition of photoelectrical signals but also triggers endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress, which leads to photoreceptor apoptosis.

pmc-13000690.title: Health Care Professionals’ and Patients’ Perceptions and Experiences of Who Uses Video Consultations, and Why: Qualitative Study
pmc-13000690.creator: Irene Muli, Åsa Cajander, Nadia Davoody, Lovisa Jäderlund Hagstedt, Helena Hvitfeldt, Maria Hägglund, Marina Taloyan, Andre Kushniruk
pmc-13000690.description: BackgroundVideo consultations (VCs) are effective and beneficial, yet their use is being discontinued, and there is a preference for face-to-face consultations.ObjectiveThis study investigates how patients and health care professionals (HCPs) perceive patients’ introduction to VCs, who use them, and what drives their use in Swedish primary care.

pmc-13137772.title: White‐Light Emission in Zeolitic Imidazolate Framework Glasses
pmc-13137772.creator: Zhencai Li, Zihao Wang, Huotian Zhang, Xuan Ge, Ivan Hung, Bozhao Yin, Fengming Cao, Pritam Banerjee, Tianzhao Xu, Lars R Jensen, Joerg Jinschek, Morten M Smedskjaer, Zhehong Gan, Laurent Calvez, Guoping Dong, Jianbei Qiu, Donghong Yu, Feng Gao, Haomiao Zhu, Yuanzheng Yue
pmc-13137772.description: Some zeolitic imidazolate frameworks (ZIFs) represent a new family of glass formers, with hitherto unknown photonic functionalities. In this work, we report the discovery of broadband white light emission in ZIF‐62, achieved through a vitrification‐pressurization‐annealing strategy. In this strategy, visible (blue) light emission was realized after the vitrification of ZIF‐62, subsequently enhanced and broadened upon pressurization.

pmc-13182538.title: Mitochondria and polycystic ovary syndrome: The role of ferroptosis, inflammasomes, and endoplasmic reticulum stress
pmc-13182538.creator: Xinyi Zhang, Tong Sun, Xinxin Wang, Yujiu Ma, Liu Cao, Jichun Tan
pmc-13182538.description: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) poses a major threat to women of reproductive age and is strongly associated with metabolic and inflammatory abnormalities. Over the past decade, tremendous progress has been made in our understanding of signaling events regulated by mitochondria. Emerging evidence underscores mitochondrial dysfunction as a central pathophysiological hub in PCOS.

pmc-13286786.title: Dwell-photo nodes in classical garden tourism: a multimodal spatial analysis of Yipu
pmc-13286786.creator: Fang Zhang, Zhide Wu, Xi Zhou
pmc-13286786.description: Sensory experiences sharing in the social media era has expanded tourism’s social influence, and visual experiences are critical for connecting visitors with specific locations. With the widespread adoption of information technology and the internet, visitors’ intentions have moved from traditional sightseeing to a hybrid experiential loop of “recording, sharing and re-disseminating.

uslaw-cfr-t25-s39-221.title: 25 C.F.R. § 39.221 — What is a full school month?
uslaw-cfr-t25-s39-221.creator: Bureau Of Indian Affairs, Department Of The Interior
uslaw-cfr-t25-s39-221.description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 25 (Indians), Part 39 (The Indian School Equalization Program).
